name: TF02-Pro
description: Mid-range 40 m single-point LiDAR in an IP65 housing, 3° beam, 100 klux sunlight immunity and a 5-12 V supply. For outdoor robots, AGVs and drone altimeters that need range past 12 m.

variants.note: 80 cm cable with JST 1.25 mm 4-pin (Molex 51021-0400): VCC (red), RXD/SDA (white), TXD/SCL (green), GND (black). DFRobot SEN0238, RobotShop RB-Ben-14.

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: Range 0.1-13.5 m on 10% reflectivity; same 40 m / 13.5 m outdoors at 100 klux
Default 100 Hz, adjustable 1-1000 Hz (2000/n). UART 115200 baud; I2C address 0x01-0x7F; I/O threshold output on the green wire
DC 5-12 V supply but 3.3 V LVTTL signals; average ≤200 mA, peak 300 mA. No reverse-polarity protection
Repeatability 1σ <2 cm (0.1-35 m on 90% target). IP65, -20 to 60 °C; 50 g including cable
Older listings (RobotShop) call it an LED rangefinder; current Benewake datasheet A02 says VCSEL. RS-485/CAN versions are the TF02-Pro-i / TF02-i
